niantic--ingress.technique: GPS location is matched against a database of geotagged landmarks, and a proximity radius decides when a player can interact with a portal, making the map itself the AR layer.
niantic--ingress.exercise_zh: 在校园地图上标出 5 个“据点”，用浏览器定位 API 判断玩家是否在 30 米内，到达即可占领；变体：两个相邻据点都被同一方占领时自动连线成领地。

niantic--pok-mon-go.technique: GPS and spawn tables place creatures near map locations, and the encounter screen overlays the creature on the camera feed using gyroscope orientation rather than full SLAM.
niantic--pok-mon-go.exercise_zh: 用陀螺仪控制一个叠加在摄像头画面上的角色，只有转向正确方向时才看得到它，滑动屏幕扔球捕捉；变体：角色只在特定天气或时段出现。

niantic--pok-mon-go-ar.technique: ARKit plane detection anchors the creature at real scale on the ground, and the camera's distance and approach speed to the anchor drive a flee behavior.
niantic--pok-mon-go-ar.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在地面放一只小动物，手机移动太快靠近时它会逃开，慢慢靠近才能摸到它；变体：蹲低身体时它会变得更信任你。

niantic--real-world-platform-occlusion-d.technique: A neural network estimates per-pixel depth from the camera image, and virtual characters are depth-tested against it so real people and objects occlude them.
niantic--real-world-platform-occlusion-d.exercise_zh: 开启 AR Foundation 的人物遮挡或环境深度遮挡，让一个角色绕着你的同学跑；变体：故意关闭遮挡再对比，拍一组前后对比截图。

niantic--codename-neon.technique: Players share a low-latency multiplayer session with a common anchor, so each phone's pose and fired projectiles are synchronized in the same world coordinates.
niantic--codename-neon.exercise_zh: 用 Unity Netcode 让两台手机在同一个图像标记坐标系下互相发射能量球，击中对方手机位置即得分；变体：地上散落的能量点被捡走后对双方都消失。

niantic--codename-tonehenge.technique: A shared anchor places one virtual structure for all players, and each player's input on a shared object state is replicated in real time so the puzzle needs coordinated action.
niantic--codename-tonehenge.exercise_zh: 放一个多人共享的 AR 石阵，每人只能旋转其中一块石头，全部对齐才能打开；变体：石头只在所有人同时看着它时才能被转动。

niantic--harry-potter-wizards-unite.technique: Touch-path gesture recognition compares the traced stroke against template glyphs and scores accuracy and speed, with the encounter object overlaid on the camera view.
niantic--harry-potter-wizards-unite.exercise_zh: 实现一个简单的手势路径识别（如 $1 Recognizer），画对符号时 AR 中的物体被释放；变体：让同学自己设计三种新符号及其效果。

niantic--pok-mon-go-buddy-adventure.technique: An animated companion is placed on a detected plane, and touch interactions such as feeding and petting change a persistent affinity value that also grows with step count.
niantic--pok-mon-go-buddy-adventure.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 小宠物，点击喂食、滑动抚摸会增加亲密度，亲密度达到阈值后解锁新动作；变体：亲密度也随你一天走的步数增长。

niantic--pok-mon-go-shared-ar-experience.technique: Nearby phones localize to a common anchor (via Lightship shared AR) so each player's companion is spawned at a shared pose and seen consistently by everyone.
niantic--pok-mon-go-shared-ar-experience.exercise_zh: 两台手机通过共同图像标记对齐，各自放出一只宠物，让它们在对方屏幕里也出现并互相打招呼；变体：两只宠物靠近时一起做一个合体动作。

niantic--pok-mon-go-ar-mapping.technique: Players capture short camera scans with pose data around landmarks, which are reconstructed into 3D maps used to build a visual positioning system.
niantic--pok-mon-go-ar-mapping.exercise_zh: 用 Polycam 或 Scaniverse 扫描校园中的一个地标，把扫描模型放回 AR 与原物对齐；变体：全班扫描同一个地标，比较不同扫描路径的效果。

niantic--pikmin-bloom.technique: Pedometer and GPS trail data are drawn as a flower path on the map, and AR mode places followers on the ground plane behind the camera position.
niantic--pikmin-bloom.exercise_zh: 记录一次散步的 GPS 轨迹，在地图上画成一条花径，并在 AR 中让一个小角色跟在你身后；变体：花的种类由你当时经过的地点类型决定。

niantic--peridot.technique: Semantic segmentation labels ground pixels as grass, water, sand and so on, and the pet's behavior tree picks actions such as digging or swimming based on the class under it.
niantic--peridot.exercise_zh: 用 Lightship 语义分割或简单的颜色判断区分草地和地板，让 AR 宠物在草地上打滚、在地板上走路；变体：把宠物放在水边时它会喝水。

niantic--hello-dot.technique: Passthrough plus scene understanding labels furniture in the room, and the pet uses those labels as navigation targets and interaction affordances.
niantic--hello-dot.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中检测桌面和地面两个层级，让宠物学会从地面跳上桌子找你；变体：你把手机放下不动时，宠物会在桌上睡着。

niantic--peridot-beyond.technique: Multiple glasses join a shared session with colocalized coordinates, so the same pet entity and its state are replicated to every wearer.
niantic--peridot-beyond.exercise_zh: 让两三台设备共享同一只 AR 宠物，谁先扔球宠物就去追谁的球；变体：宠物会记住最常陪它玩的人。

niantic--monster-hunter-now-palico-ar.technique: A companion character is placed on a detected surface in a photo mode with pose presets and camera capture, turning AR into a snapshot tool.
niantic--monster-hunter-now-palico-ar.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 拍照模式：放置角色、选择姿势、一键截图并保存；变体：截图时自动加一个与当前地点相关的边框。

8th-wall--lightship-vps-for-web.technique: Browser camera frames are matched against a prebuilt map of a location to return a 6DoF pose, letting WebAR content be anchored to a specific place.
8th-wall--lightship-vps-for-web.exercise_zh: 用图像标记在网页 AR 中模拟“地点定位”：扫描门口的海报后，内容固定出现在门框上；变体：每次打开时显示上一位访客留下的一句话。

novarama--invizimals.technique: A printed fiducial card gives the camera pose for tabletop rendering, while a color-detection capture step (pointing the camera at certain hues) is used to spawn creatures.
novarama--invizimals.exercise_zh: 用摄像头颜色检测“发现”隐藏生物：对准某种颜色的物体时出现提示，再在图像标记卡上召唤它；变体：不同颜色对应不同属性的生物。

novarama--invizimals-shadow-zone.technique: Marker-based tracking on the trap card anchors creatures and battle effects, with capture challenges requiring the player to move the handheld relative to the marker.
novarama--invizimals-shadow-zone.exercise_zh: 设计一个需要移动手机围绕标记卡才能完成的捕捉挑战，例如从特定角度对准生物；变体：捕捉时间窗口随生物稀有度缩短。

novarama--invizimals-the-lost-tribes.technique: The marker card defines the arena origin, and creatures from different sets are rendered in the card's frame with turn-based battle animations.
novarama--invizimals-the-lost-tribes.exercise_zh: 用两张不同的图像标记卡分别召唤两个阵营的角色，让它们在桌上回合制对战；变体：把两张卡的距离作为攻击范围的一个参数。

novarama--invizimals-the-alliance-the-lo.technique: Creatures captured in the handheld AR mode are saved to a shared profile and loaded as playable characters in a separate console game, linking two devices through data.
novarama--invizimals-the-alliance-the-lo.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中“捕捉”一个角色并保存为 JSON，再在电脑上的 Unity 场景中读取它作为可控角色；变体：在电脑上升级后，手机 AR 里的角色外观也改变。

sce-london-studio--eyepet.technique: A fixed camera uses a marker card to locate the floor, and frame-differencing motion detection lets the player's hand movements near the pet count as touches.
sce-london-studio--eyepet.exercise_zh: 用网页摄像头和帧差法检测手在画面某区域的移动，让屏幕上的虚拟宠物被“摸”时做出反应；变体：在纸上画一个圆，宠物把它当成球来玩。

sce-london-studio--eyepet-playstation-mo.technique: The Move controller's glowing ball is tracked by the camera for position and its IMU for orientation, so it can be rendered as swappable virtual tools in the pet's space.
sce-london-studio--eyepet-playstation-mo.exercise_zh: 用手机当道具控制器，把它的姿态映射成 AR 中的吹风机、刷子等工具，给宠物梳洗；变体：每种工具有独特的声音反馈。

sce-london-studio--eyepet-friends.technique: Two tracked controllers and pet instances share the camera-based floor frame, letting two players' pets interact in the same augmented video.
sce-london-studio--eyepet-friends.exercise_zh: 在同一个 AR 画面里放两只宠物，分别由两名玩家控制，让它们根据距离做出互动；变体：两只宠物有各自的性格，会产生冲突。

sce-london-studio--wonderbook-book-of-sp.technique: Each page of the book carries a distinct marker, so page identity and pose drive which pop-up scene is rendered, while the tracked Move wand gestures cast spells into it.
sce-london-studio--wonderbook-book-of-sp.exercise_zh: 用一本小册子，每页贴一个不同的图像标记，翻页时在 AR 中弹出对应的立体场景；变体：用手机当魔杖，在页面上方挥动触发变化。

sce-london-studio--wonderbook-book-of-po.technique: The book marker anchors a virtual cauldron, and controller motion patterns such as grinding and pouring are recognized from IMU data to add ingredients.
sce-london-studio--wonderbook-book-of-po.exercise_zh: 在图像标记上放一口 AR 锅，用手机的摇晃、倾倒动作（加速度计）添加不同原料，配方正确时冒出彩色烟雾；变体：配方需要按正确顺序加入。

nintendo--ar-games-nintendo-3ds.technique: A known printed card provides a fiducial for camera pose, and the stereo 3D display renders content emerging from the table plane around the card.
nintendo--ar-games-nintendo-3ds.exercise_zh: 用一张打印的图像标记做一个从桌面“裂开”钻出来的 AR 巨龙，可以用 Stencil 做出桌面洞口；变体：把标记放在不同表面上，巨龙的反应不同。

nintendo--ar-games-fishing.technique: The card marks the table as a water plane using a stencil or depth mask, and tilting and moving the console are mapped to the fishing line and reel.
nintendo--ar-games-fishing.exercise_zh: 在桌面上用 Shader 做一个“水面”，倾斜手机抛竿，快速上抬手机收线；变体：鱼只在你保持安静时才会上钩（用麦克风判断）。

nintendo--face-raiders.technique: A captured face photo is texture-mapped onto enemy meshes, and the gyroscope rotates the virtual camera so enemies surround the player in a 360-degree space overlaid on the camera feed.
nintendo--face-raiders.exercise_zh: 用前置摄像头拍一张脸，贴到 AR 中飞来飞去的球体上，转身用陀螺仪瞄准射击；变体：被击中的脸会做出不同表情。

nintendo--kid-icarus-uprising-ar-cards.technique: Two cards are detected at once as image targets, and the relative pose between them determines the characters' facing and battle stats.
nintendo--kid-icarus-uprising-ar-cards.exercise_zh: 用两张图像标记卡各召唤一个角色，卡片距离越近两者越激动，对面朝向时开始战斗；变体：卡片叠放时两个角色合体。

nintendo--spirit-camera-the-cursed-memoi.technique: Pages in a printed booklet act as image targets that trigger story events, while gyroscope-based aiming lets ghosts appear around the player in the camera view.
nintendo--spirit-camera-the-cursed-memoi.exercise_zh: 制作一本几页的纸质“诅咒日记”，每页扫描后触发一段 AR 鬼影或声音；变体：只能在熄灯时（摄像头亮度低时）看到鬼影。

velan-studios--mario-kart-live-home-circ.technique: Fiducial markers on cardboard gates localize the RC car's onboard camera, so the track, items and rivals are rendered from the kart's viewpoint over its live video.
velan-studios--mario-kart-live-home-circ.exercise_zh: 把手机固定在玩具车上，在地上放几张图像标记当“关卡门”，经过时在 AR 中显示加速道具；变体：把门的顺序设计成一条只有 AR 里才看得见的赛道。

velan-studios--mario-kart-live-home-circ.technique: The gates both define the track path and correct camera pose drift, and rendering is tuned to minimize latency between the car's video and its overlays.
velan-studios--mario-kart-live-home-circ.exercise_zh: 测量自己 AR 原型中从相机画面到叠加内容的延迟（如用高速录像），并尝试一种降低延迟的方法；变体：故意加大延迟，观察用户开始不舒服的临界点。

velan-studios--hot-wheels-rift-rally.technique: A camera car streams video to a phone or console that tracks gate markers for localization and overlays track geometry and effects in the car's perspective.
velan-studios--hot-wheels-rift-rally.exercise_zh: 用手机远程查看另一台手机（放在小车上）的摄像头画面，并在画面上叠加 AR 赛道元素；变体：加入只在车经过某张图片后出现的“裂缝”特效。

google-creative-lab--just-a-line.technique: The line is built from successive camera or touch-ray positions in world space extruded into a ribbon mesh, and Cloud Anchors share the anchor so two phones draw together.
google-creative-lab--just-a-line.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 把手机移动时的位置连成一条 3D 线，再录屏导出；变体：线只能画一笔，中途松手就结束。

google-creative-lab--just-a-line-with-sh.technique: The same world-space line drawing is used by an artist whose single continuous stroke becomes a spatial drawing around her body.
google-creative-lab--just-a-line-with-sh.exercise_zh: 邀请一位同学在 AR 中用一笔画绕着自己的身体画一幅画，并从多角度录像；变体：把画出来的线导出为模型，再 3D 打印。

google-creative-lab--ar-experiments-arco.technique: Small experiments each isolate one ARCore capability such as plane detection, hit testing, light estimation or anchors, showing how a single technique can carry a toy.
google-creative-lab--ar-experiments-arco.exercise_zh: 每组选一个 AR 基础能力（平面检测、光照估计、锚点等），在一小时内做一个只依赖该能力的小玩具；变体：互相交换能力再做一个。

google-creative-lab--drawalong-ar.technique: A video plane is anchored to a detected paper surface with adjustable transparency, so the user can trace the tutorial through the overlay.
google-creative-lab--drawalong-ar.exercise_zh: 在桌面平面上放一个半透明的视频或图片层，对齐真实纸张后描画；变体：让叠加内容逐笔出现，像一位老师在示范。

google-creative-lab--d-i-s-p-l-a-y-e-d-a.technique: Indoor positioning estimates the visitor's location, and distance to each performer's position controls the volume of their audio track.
google-creative-lab--d-i-s-p-l-a-y-e-d-a.exercise_zh: 在教室里布置 4 个“声音点”，根据手机与每个点的距离调整对应音频的音量，形成可走动的声音地图；变体：声音点对应的是同学讲述的一段个人故事。

google-creative-lab--sounds-in-space.technique: ARCore anchors store audio sources at positions in a room, and playback volume and panning follow the phone's tracked position.
google-creative-lab--sounds-in-space.exercise_zh: 用 AR Foundation 在房间里放置几个带 3D 音效的隐形声音源，走动时听到不同的音乐层；变体：让观众自己录一段声音并放进空间里。

google-creative-lab--lines-of-play.technique: The ARCore Depth API supplies a depth map used for both occlusion and physics collision, so dominoes hide behind and bump into real objects.
google-creative-lab--lines-of-play.exercise_zh: 开启环境深度，在桌面上摆一排 AR 多米诺骨牌，让它们撞到真实的书本后停下；变体：骨牌倒下时每块发出一个音阶，组成一段旋律。

jonas-jongejan--ar-wormhole.technique: A 360 camera stream is buffered with a delay and mapped onto an inside-out sphere visible through a stencil portal, so stepping through shows the scene from seconds ago.
jonas-jongejan--ar-wormhole.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 传送门，门内播放 10 秒前用手机录下的同一地点的视频；变体：把延迟改成一天前或一年前，思考它讲的是什么故事。

jonas-jongejan--arcore-drawing-ofxarcore.technique: Camera pose from ARCore is exposed to openFrameworks, and positions sampled while touching are connected into 3D polylines rendered in world space.
jonas-jongejan--arcore-drawing-ofxarcore.exercise_zh: 不用 Unity，改用 three.js + WebXR 实现一个空中画线工具，比较两种工具链的开发体验；变体：线条颜色随画线速度变化。

jeri-ellsworth--castar-kickstarter.technique: Head-mounted projectors cast a stereo image onto a retro-reflective mat that returns light mainly to its source, so each wearer sees only their own head-tracked perspective.
jeri-ellsworth--castar-kickstarter.exercise_zh: 用手机前置人脸追踪实现头部耦合透视，把桌面上的平板变成一个有纵深的“全息桌面”；变体：两人从不同角度看同一个平板，讨论为什么只有一人看到正确透视。

jeri-ellsworth--castar-at-maker-faire-20.technique: Head tracking relative to the mat, likely via camera-tracked markers, updates the off-axis stereo projection so holograms stay locked to the table.
jeri-ellsworth--castar-at-maker-faire-20.exercise_zh: 用一个低成本材料（反光胶带或手电筒）做一个小实验，观察回射材料如何把光送回光源；变体：据此画出一个你设想的桌面 AR 设备草图。

jeri-ellsworth--castar-smartglasses-at-a.technique: Because each wearer's projector image returns only to their own eyes, multiple players can share one surface with individually correct perspective views.
jeri-ellsworth--castar-smartglasses-at-a.exercise_zh: 设计一个多人桌面游戏，每个玩家看到的信息不同（比如手牌只有自己能看），用多台手机 AR 围绕同一张图像标记实现；变体：加入一张所有人都能看到的公共牌。

jeri-ellsworth--tilt-five-holographic-ga.technique: Glasses project stereo images onto a retro-reflective board and track head pose against it, while a tracked wand gives a ray for pointing at tabletop content.
jeri-ellsworth--tilt-five-holographic-ga.exercise_zh: 在 AR 中把一张图像标记当成游戏棋盘，用手机射线（从屏幕中心发出）选择棋子并移动；变体：棋子可以“站起来”超出棋盘高度。

jeri-ellsworth--tilt-five-gaming-with-ta.technique: Content is authored in board-local coordinates in Unity, so miniatures appear to rise from the board and stay registered as players move their heads.
jeri-ellsworth--tilt-five-gaming-with-ta.exercise_zh: 做一个从桌面“长出来”的小城市，城市建筑随你绕桌子行走的角度显示不同细节；变体：城市里的小人会朝你所在的方向看。

directive-games--the-machines-apple-keyn.technique: ARKit world tracking places a detailed battlefield on the table, and the player's physical movement around it becomes the camera control, revealing new sightlines.
directive-games--the-machines-apple-keyn.exercise_zh: 在桌上放一个 AR 迷宫城堡，只有走到某个角度才能看到隐藏的入口；变体：入口在两个人分别站在两侧时才会同时出现。

directive-games--the-machines.technique: Two phones share one tabletop anchor and a synchronized game state, with each phone acting as a free-moving camera over the miniature battlefield.
directive-games--the-machines.exercise_zh: 用网络同步做一个两人桌面 AR 对战，每人从自己的角度看同一张地图；变体：每个人只能看到自己单位附近的区域（战争迷雾）。

snap-inc--snapchat-world-lenses.technique: Rear-camera SLAM with ground detection anchors an animated character to the floor, and video recording captures the composited result for sharing.
snap-inc--snapchat-world-lenses.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 做一个地面上的动画角色 World Lens，录一段 10 秒短视频；变体：角色会模仿镜头前真人的动作（用身体追踪）。

snap-inc--jeff-koons-x-snapchat.technique: Geofenced lenses become available only near specific coordinates, and the sculpture is placed with ground tracking at a fixed site.
snap-inc--jeff-koons-x-snapchat.exercise_zh: 为校园中的某个地点设计一件只在那里可见的 AR 雕塑，用 GPS 限制出现范围；变体：让同学在雕塑旁留下 AR 涂鸦，思考公共空间的归属问题。

snap-inc--landmarkers.technique: Landmark tracking matches the camera view to a prebuilt 3D model of a known building, so shaders and animations can be mapped precisely onto its real facade.
snap-inc--landmarkers.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 的 Custom Landmarker 或图像追踪识别校园中一栋建筑立面，在它上面叠加融化或长草的动画；变体：让动画跟随真实时间变化。

snap-inc--local-lenses.technique: A city-scale 3D map localizes users, and shared persistent state stores each paint stroke on building surfaces so later visitors see the accumulated changes.
snap-inc--local-lenses.exercise_zh: 用持久化锚点和一个简单后端（如 Firebase）做一面多人共享的 AR 涂鸦墙，涂鸦下次打开还在；变体：涂鸦会像真实油漆一样慢慢褪色。

ines-alpha--future-gloss.technique: A face mesh from face tracking drives 3D liquid geometry attached to facial landmarks, with glossy PBR materials and an environment map for reflections.
ines-alpha--future-gloss.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 或 Effect House 在脸上放一个跟随面部网格的 3D 液体造型，调出高光反射材质；变体：让液体随嘴巴张合流动。

ines-alpha--ines-alpha-x-katsu.technique: Sculptural meshes modeled in Cinema 4D are parented to face-tracking anchors, with iridescent shader effects that change with view angle.
ines-alpha--ines-alpha-x-katsu.exercise_zh: 用任意 3D 软件做一个雕塑感的小物件，挂在人脸追踪的某个锚点（如额头或颧骨）上；变体：物件随面部表情展开或收起。

ines-alpha--ines-alpha-x-the-bulletproof.technique: Translucent organic meshes are bound to the face mesh and deform with blendshape-driven expressions, using refraction or transparency shaders.
ines-alpha--ines-alpha-x-the-bulletproof.exercise_zh: 用 ARKit blendshape 读取表情系数，驱动脸上一个半透明形体的大小或形状；变体：只在微笑时让形体发光。

ines-alpha--bimba-y-lola-x-ines-alpha-fi.technique: Spark AR face tracking attaches glossy 3D makeup meshes to the face, with materials art-directed to match a fashion collection's palette.
ines-alpha--bimba-y-lola-x-ines-alpha-fi.exercise_zh: 从一件服装或一张海报中提取配色，做一个与之呼应的人脸 AR 滤镜；变体：滤镜根据镜头中服装颜色自动改变。

ines-alpha--prada-beauty-rethinking-beau.technique: A multi-mode face filter switches between makeup looks via tap or picker UI, each combining face-mesh textures, attached 3D pieces and animated shaders.
ines-alpha--prada-beauty-rethinking-beau.exercise_zh: 做一个有三种模式的人脸滤镜，点击屏幕在模式间切换，每种模式代表一种对“未来妆容”的理解；变体：模式切换由眨眼触发。

johanna-jaskowska--beauty3000.technique: The face mesh is re-textured with a glossy material that uses an iridescent or matcap environment reflection, so highlights shift as the head moves.
johanna-jaskowska--beauty3000.exercise_zh: 用 Effect House 或 Lens Studio 给脸部网格一个彩虹色的 Matcap 材质，观察转头时高光的变化；变体：把材质换成一种你身边真实物件的质感。

marc-wakefield--spark-ar-world-effects.technique: Hand-drawn 2D artwork is placed as billboards or layered planes in world space via plane tracking, preserving the illustration style in 3D.
marc-wakefield--spark-ar-world-effects.exercise_zh: 把自己的手绘角色分成前、中、后三层平面，放进 AR 形成有视差的纸片剧场；变体：绕着它走时，角色永远转身面对你。

paige-piskin--lil-cartoon-bratz-doll.technique: A machine-learning face transformation (likely a GAN-based style model) restyles the face into a cartoon while keeping head pose and expression.
paige-piskin--lil-cartoon-bratz-doll.exercise_zh: 用 Lens Studio 的 ML 风格化或人脸变形工具，把脸变成一种你童年玩具的风格；变体：写一段说明，解释你保留了原脸的哪些特征。

paige-piskin--coachella-metabutterfly-fi.technique: Face-tracked butterfly meshes and makeup textures are anchored to facial landmarks, with wing animations driven by time or facial movement.
paige-piskin--coachella-metabutterfly-fi.exercise_zh: 在脸上放几只沿眉毛或颧骨停驻的 AR 蝴蝶，张嘴时它们飞走；变体：蝴蝶飞离后会停到画面中的真实物体上。

paige-piskin--coachella-luminous-filter.technique: Face-attached emissive materials with bloom are modulated by camera luminance or light estimation, so the glow reacts to the surrounding lighting.
paige-piskin--coachella-luminous-filter.exercise_zh: 做一个会根据环境亮度改变发光强度的脸部滤镜，暗处更亮、亮处更淡；变体：用麦克风音量代替亮度来驱动发光。

tonchidot--sekai-camera-techcrunch50-dem.technique: GPS position and compass heading determine which geotagged notes lie in the camera's field of view, and tags are drawn as floating labels at their bearing.
tonchidot--sekai-camera-techcrunch50-dem.exercise_zh: 用手机 GPS 和指南针在网页上实现“浮空标签”：朝向某个方向时显示那里的留言；变体：标签字体大小按距离缩放，远处的留言变模糊。

tonchidot--sekai-camera-science-museum-n.technique: Location-tagged labels pointing to exhibits are overlaid on the camera view based on device position and heading, working as indoor wayfinding.
tonchidot--sekai-camera-science-museum-n.exercise_zh: 在教学楼里放几个二维码或图像标记，扫描后在 AR 中显示指向下一个地点的箭头；变体：箭头的样式由上一位访客的评价决定。

tonchidot--sekai-camera-for-ipad.technique: The same geotag overlay approach is applied on a larger screen, with the device treated as a handheld window onto the tag layer.
tonchidot--sekai-camera-for-ipad.exercise_zh: 对比手机和平板上同一个 AR 标签界面，调整标签密度和字号以适配大屏；变体：设计一种只在大屏上才有意义的交互。

layar--layar-reality-browser.technique: Points of interest from third-party layers are fetched by API and rendered as camera-overlay markers using GPS, compass and accelerometer for bearing and elevation.
layar--layar-reality-browser.exercise_zh: 用一个开放数据接口（如 OpenStreetMap）获取附近的咖啡店，用 GPS + 指南针在摄像头画面中按方向显示；变体：只显示你从没去过的地方。

layar--layar-for-google-glass.technique: Image recognition matches printed pages against a database, triggering linked content in a head-worn display without needing a touch screen.
layar--layar-for-google-glass.exercise_zh: 为一张课程海报做图像识别触发，扫描后播放一段 15 秒的介绍视频；变体：同一张海报在不同时间扫描显示不同内容。

otavio-good--word-lens.technique: On-device OCR finds text regions, a dictionary translates them, and the original text is painted over with sampled background color and redrawn in a matching font.
otavio-good--word-lens.exercise_zh: 用 Google ML Kit 或 Tesseract 识别画面中的文字，把它替换成另一种语言或另一句话并贴回原位；变体：把所有标识都替换成反义词。

otavio-good--word-lens-for-glass.technique: The OCR and in-place replacement pipeline runs on head-worn camera frames, so translation appears in view without holding a device.
otavio-good--word-lens-for-glass.exercise_zh: 用手机前后摄像头模拟眼镜视角做“免手持”文字翻译，并讨论眼镜上需要如何简化界面；变体：只用语音朗读翻译结果，不显示文字。

wonderscope-within--wonderscope.technique: Life-size characters are placed on the floor via plane detection, and speech recognition checks the child's spoken line against the script to advance the story.
wonderscope-within--wonderscope.exercise_zh: 做一个三句对白的 AR 小故事，角色站在地上，孩子读出正确台词后剧情才继续；变体：读错时角色会用幽默方式提示。

wonderscope-within--clio-s-cosmic-quest.technique: Story scenes are staged in room-scale world coordinates, and voice-recognition gates plus walking prompts pace the narrative.
wonderscope-within--clio-s-cosmic-quest.exercise_zh: 设计一个需要观众走到房间另一侧才能看到下一幕的 AR 故事；变体：观众必须说出某个星球的名字才能“起飞”。

wonderscope-within--wonder-s-land-ringma.technique: Characters are arranged around the viewer in a circle, and speech input triggers performer animations, making the child a participant.
wonderscope-within--wonder-s-land-ringma.exercise_zh: 在观众周围一圈放几个 AR 表演者，观众说出口令时轮到对应的表演者登场；变体：观众说话声音越大，表演越夸张。

wonderscope-within--willowcrest-manor.technique: Room-scale placement of set pieces and characters, likely with scripted triggers based on where the viewer looks, turns the child's room into a staged mystery.
wonderscope-within--willowcrest-manor.exercise_zh: 做一个基于视线触发的 AR 悬疑场景：只有看向某个角落时才出现线索；变体：线索出现后如果你移开视线，它会换位置。

wonderscope-within--sinclair-snake.technique: An animated character rig is anchored in the room, and scene transitions are triggered by the child's spoken responses via speech recognition.
wonderscope-within--sinclair-snake.exercise_zh: 让一个 AR 角色向你提问，根据你的语音回答分出两条不同的剧情分支；变体：角色会记住你上次的回答。

climax-studios--arise.technique: Perspective-alignment puzzles check the camera's viewing angle relative to the diorama, and when disconnected paths line up in screen space the level treats them as connected.
climax-studios--arise.exercise_zh: 在桌上放一组错位的 AR 积木，只有从某个特定角度看时它们才连成一条路；变体：做一个需要两个角度先后对齐的关卡。

climax-studios--towers-for-tango.technique: Tango's depth sensor builds a room mesh, and towers and enemy paths are placed on real floors and furniture surfaces from that mesh.
climax-studios--towers-for-tango.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的 iPhone 做网格重建，把敌人的行进路线放在真实地面上并绕开家具；变体：玩家可以挪动真实椅子来改变路线。

kunabi-brother--euclidean-lands-ar.technique: A rotating cube-world puzzle is placed on a detected table, and its grid-based rotation logic is unchanged while the camera view comes from the player walking around it.
kunabi-brother--euclidean-lands-ar.exercise_zh: 做一个可以整体旋转的 AR 小立方体世界，旋转后角色可以走上新的路径；变体：旋转只能通过绕着桌子走来完成。

resolution-games--angry-birds-ar-isle-of.technique: Destructible physics structures are built at room scale on the floor plane, and a slingshot is aimed from the camera position so the player walks to find angles.
resolution-games--angry-birds-ar-isle-of.exercise_zh: 在地面上放一座 AR 积木塔，从手机位置用弹弓发射小球，鼓励玩家走到侧面找弱点；变体：塔的形状由真实房间的空地大小自动决定。

mighty-coconut--57-north.technique: The Merge Cube's patterned faces are tracked as a multi-face image target, so a diorama follows the cube's rotation and choices are made by turning it.
mighty-coconut--57-north.exercise_zh: 用纸盒六面贴图像标记做一个自制 Merge Cube，在盒子上显示一个小故事场景，转到不同面时做出不同选择；变体：摇晃盒子会让场景里下雨。

merge-labs--merge-cube.technique: The cube's six unique patterns form a single tracked object target, giving full 6DoF pose so a hologram can be held and turned in the hand.
merge-labs--merge-cube.exercise_zh: 打印并折一个带图案的纸立方体，用 Vuforia 或 8th Wall 追踪它，在手中显示一颗可旋转的行星；变体：把两块立方体靠近时触发化学反应。

novum-analytics--night-terrors.technique: The phone camera feed is darkened and lit by a virtual flashlight, and apparitions are overlaid with jump-scare timing and spatial audio through headphones.
novum-analytics--night-terrors.exercise_zh: 做一个只在手机“手电筒”光圈里才显示 AR 内容的场景，配合耳机中的方位声音；变体：光圈越小，恐怖元素越近。

novum-analytics--night-terrors-bloody-ma.technique: ARKit or ARCore world tracking lets a ghost character move through room space relative to the player, with audio cues giving direction.
novum-analytics--night-terrors-bloody-ma.exercise_zh: 让一个 AR 角色在你背后移动，只能通过声音判断它的位置，转身时它躲到视野外；变体：用前置摄像头检测你是否在“镜子”前。

lego--lego-hidden-side.technique: The app recognizes the physical LEGO set (model or image-based tracking), and ghosts are rendered inside it with occlusion from a known digital model of the set.
lego--lego-hidden-side.exercise_zh: 用一个真实的纸盒模型和它的简化 3D 替身做遮挡，让 AR 幽灵躲在纸盒里的窗户后面；变体：打开真实盒子的某扇门会放出幽灵。

mojang-minecraft-earth--minecraft-earth.technique: Build plates are authored at tabletop scale and rescaled to life size with the same anchor, while Azure Spatial Anchors let multiple players share the placement.
mojang-minecraft-earth--minecraft-earth.exercise_zh: 在桌上用 AR 方块搭一个小模型，一键放大到真实尺寸并走进去；变体：放大后另一位同学可以在同一位置看到它。

zenka--augmented-reality-street-art.technique: The printed artwork is registered as an image target, and a video or animation layer is aligned to it so the static piece appears to move.
zenka--augmented-reality-street-art.exercise_zh: 用 8th Wall 或 Lens Studio 把一张自己的海报设为图像目标，扫描后播放它的动画版本；变体：动画只在有人站在海报前时继续。

zenka--space-mural-aurasma.technique: An image recognition service matches the mural and triggers an overlay animation registered to the painted surface.
zenka--space-mural-aurasma.exercise_zh: 在白板上画一幅简单壁画，用图像追踪让其中的元素飞出来；变体：邀请同学在壁画上添加一笔，观察识别是否仍然有效。

zenka--augmented-reality-linoleum-prints.technique: High-contrast hand-carved prints serve as image targets with strong feature points, and animations are aligned to the printed forms.
zenka--augmented-reality-linoleum-prints.exercise_zh: 用橡皮章或手绘做一张高对比度图案，测试它作为图像标记的识别效果，并加上对应动画；变体：印出多张有细微差异的版画，每张触发不同动画。

novarama--reality-fighters.technique: A photographed face is mapped onto a fighter's head, and the characters are rendered over the rear camera feed anchored by an AR card.
novarama--reality-fighters.exercise_zh: 用前置摄像头拍脸贴到 AR 格斗小人头上，在桌面上和同学的小人对打；变体：打输的一方脸部贴图会出现“伤痕”。

tender-claws--tendar.technique: Front-camera facial expression classification feeds the pet's emotional state, while rear-camera object recognition checks whether the player shows the requested item.
tender-claws--tendar.exercise_zh: 用表情识别（MediaPipe 或 ARKit blendshape）判断你是否在笑，AR 小鱼以你的情绪为食；变体：小鱼会请你拍一个指定物体，并用物体识别验证。

sce-japan-studio--the-eye-of-judgment.technique: CyberCode markers on each card are decoded by an overhead camera to identify the card and its grid cell, and animated creatures are rendered on the video of the mat.
sce-japan-studio--the-eye-of-judgment.exercise_zh: 制作 4 张带不同图像标记的卡片，放在 2×2 格子上时召唤对应角色，并根据相邻关系判定胜负；变体：卡片旋转方向决定角色面朝哪边。

niantic--pok-mon-go-snapshot.technique: A character is placed on a detected plane, and a photo mode lets the user move closer and frame the shot, with scripted random events adding a second character.
niantic--pok-mon-go-snapshot.exercise_zh: 做一个 AR 拍照模式，拍照时有 20% 的概率冒出一个“乱入者”；变体：乱入者会根据画面中是否有人脸做出不同动作。

8th-wall--8th-wall-sizzle-reel-2023.technique: Browser-based SLAM, face tracking and image targets run in a mobile web page, so each experience opens from a link or QR code without an app install.
8th-wall--8th-wall-sizzle-reel-2023.exercise_zh: 选一个 WebAR 模板（人脸、图像或世界追踪），在 2 小时内做一个能用二维码打开的小作品并现场分享；变体：作品必须与班级所在城市有关。

8th-wall--microsoft-mixed-reality-captur.technique: Volumetric video (a sequence of textured meshes) is streamed and played in sync with audio, and anchored at life size on a detected ground plane in the browser.
8th-wall--microsoft-mixed-reality-captur.exercise_zh: 用手机抠像（背景分离）录一段同学的视频，作为面向镜头的平面“全息人”放在 AR 地面上；变体：让这个全息人在你走近时转头看你。
